tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Content of one page of bitspire.ch as Markdown. German pages are unprefixed, English pages start with /en.

tools.name: get_site_overview
tools.description: Overview of BitSpire GmbH: services, key pages with URLs, team and references.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Full-text search over all pages and blog posts of bitspire.ch. Returns the best matching pages with title, path and a snippet; read a result with get_page.

tools.name: start_inquiry
tools.description: Creates a link to the BitSpire contact form, prefilled with a subject and message. Nothing is sent: give the link to the user, who adds name and email and submits it. Do not put personal data such as email addresses or phone numbers into the message.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_site_overview, search_site · Private data: start_inquiry · Public sink: start_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_site_overview, search_site · Private data: start_inquiry · Public sink: start_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
